Title: Expand domain model: centers, groups, instructors, students

Description:
Introduce richer domain entities inspired by `academy-manager` so the app can support organized centers, groups (classes), instructors and student records.

Acceptance Criteria:
- New data models and collections for `centers`, `groups`, `instructors` and `students`.
- API endpoints or GraphQL types to manage these entities.
- Migration or seed script for initial data.

Labels: enhancement
